researchTopics.outcome: Revision 2, re-evidenced against FalconDocs/OfficialDocs (crowdstrike-auth.pdf p42-44, spotlight.pdf p19-21/p28, discover.pdf p4/p12). A3 REJECTED as written: it is a TOKEN BUCKET - 100 req/s sustained per CID, 6,000-token burst capacity, 100/s refill - pooled across all API clients and endpoints; not Spotlight-specific and not exclusively ours. A4 VALIDATED: 120s after-token TTL is vendor-documented verbatim for the exact endpoint (retracts the revision-1 claim that it was undocumented; the code comment is correct). No concurrency limit documented in any of the three PDFs (verified negative). A4a raised OPEN: spotlight.pdf p19 says an expired after token returns a 200 OK header with 404 under errors in the body, while FalconHttpFailureClassifier.cs:22 keys on the 404 status line - needs a 130s cursor probe to settle. Recommended degree default 4, clamp 16.
